item.title: The Shikoku Pilgrimage in Tokushima: Temple 1 — Guide
item.description: The Shikoku Pilgrimage, a 1,200-kilometre circuit of 88 temples linked to the revered monk Kobo Daishi (Kukai), traditionally begins in Tokushima, the old province of Awa. Ryozen-ji, near Naruto, is Temple 1 — the customary starting point where pilgrims prepare for the journey, buy their white robes, staff and other gear, and set out. Tokushima represents the pilgrimage’s first stage, the ‘dojo of awakening’ (hosshin), and its 23 temples introduce the rhythm of temple visits, prayer and walking that defines the whole route.
